os:store.doc:name: Create Active Run Lock
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, businessDate: vars.businessDate, status: "PROCESSING", startedAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output application/java
var startedAt = vars.existingActiveRunLock.startedAt default null
var thresholdHours = (vars.staleLockThresholdHours default 2) as Number
var thresholdPeriod = ( "PT" ++ (thresholdHours as String) ++ "H" ) as Period
--- if (startedAt == null) false else now() > ((startedAt as DateTime) + thresholdPeriod)

logger.doc:name: Log Stale Active Run Lock
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_STALE_RUN_LOCK_DETECTED", currentRunId: vars.runId, staleOwnerRunId: vars.existingLockOwnerRunId, staleLockStartedAt: vars.existingLockStartedAt, thresholdHours: vars.staleLockThresholdHours default 2, lockKey: Mule::p("lock.activeKey"), runStatus: vars.runStatus }]

os:store.doc:name: Create Active Run Lock After Recovery
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, businessDate: vars.businessDate, status: "PROCESSING", startedAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

logger.doc:name: Log Stale Lock Recovery Completed
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_STALE_RUN_LOCK_RECOVERED", runId: vars.runId, previousOwnerRunId: vars.existingLockOwnerRunId, lockKey: Mule::p("lock.activeKey"), lockAcquired: vars.lockAcquired, runStatus: vars.runStatus, recoveredAt: (now() >> ("Asia/Kolkata" as TimeZone)) as String { format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSXXX" } }]

set-variable.doc:name: Set Already Running After Recovery Conflict

logger.doc:name: Log Recovered Lock Status
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_STALE_LOCK_RECOVERY_CONFLICT", runId: vars.runId, previousOwnerRunId: vars.existingLockOwnerRunId, lockKey: Mule::p("lock.activeKey"), runStatus: vars.runStatus, message: "The stale lock was removed, but another execution acquired the active-run lock first." }]

logger.doc:name: Log Active Run Lock Conflict
logger.message: #[output application/json --- { event: "INVENTORY_RUN_LOCK_NOT_ACQUIRED", runId: vars.runId, triggerType: vars.triggerType, sourceFilePath: vars.sourceFilePath, runStatus: vars.runStatus, lockKey: "${lock.activeKey}", existingLockOwnerRunId: vars.existingLockOwnerRunId, existingLockStartedAt: vars.existingLockStartedAt, staleLockDetected: false, message: "Another inventory execution is currently active." }]
